regions.name: East Africa
regions.role: Register-led and tender-heavy. One dossier format across the region.
regions.insight: Seven East African regulators share assessment work and the CTD format is mandatory. Done right once, a dossier opens the region.
keyFacts: CTD format mandatory across the region

faq.q: Are you an agent, a consultant or a distributor?
faq.a: An agent. We never take title to stock. We read the market, register your products, appoint the importer, run promotion and state bids, and report weekly.

Terms are agreed per market before anything starts: a fee for defined work such as market reads, registration and monitoring, and commission on sales where we run the market for you. You know the full picture up front.

faq.q: Whose name is on the registration?
faq.a: Yours. Registrations are always held in the manufacturer's name. We act as your local representative and are never the holder.

faq.q: We already have a distributor in that market.
faq.a: Then we look at whether they are the right one. Because the registration is yours, the importer can always be replaced.
Typically 12–24 months after filing, depending on the market and the route.

faq.q: What do you need from us to start?
faq.a: One line on what you want. We follow up for product details ourselves. Dossiers come only for the products you take forward.

faq.q: Is what we share kept confidential?
faq.a: Yes. Anything you share is used to read the market for you and nothing else.
All 14 markets we serve. Kazakhstan is the one we show in full on this site; every market gets the same read.
People, using our own software. You are not buying a login: our team does the work and you get the result, weekly.

faq.q: What do you need from us?
faq.a: One person for about a week at the start: your catalogue, supplier list, markets and priorities. After that, a weekly read and a call when a decision is needed.
It is used for your partnership only. Not pooled, not resold, not used for anyone else. This is written into the agreement.

faq.q: How long does a market read take?
faq.a: Two to three weeks from our first call.
Every product rated open, thin or crowded in each market, with the competition, where your price lands and a recommended launch order. We walk you through it on a call.
A fixed fee for the read, quoted after the first call and agreed before we start. It depends on how many markets and products you want read.

faq.q: Do I need dossiers or registrations first?
faq.a: No. The read comes first, so you only prepare dossiers for the products worth filing.

faq.q: Can I start with one market or a few products?
faq.a: Yes. Many manufacturers start with one market or a short list and add more later.
Our market data is kept current market by market. If you want it watched after the read, Monitoring reports changes weekly.
If a market is open, we propose how to enter it and what it would take. You decide whether to go further.
